# Municipal Ordinance No. 01, Series of 2019

**Kautusang Bayan Blg. 01**

*Isang Kautusang Bayan na Magtatakda ng mga Patakaran upang Mabigyan ng Daloy ng Kuryente ang mga Tirahan/Tahanan ng mga Makikinabang na Mamamayan (Beneficiary) sa Bayan ng Pitogo, Lalawigan ng Quezon*

An ordinance prescribing policies to provide electricity flow to beneficiary households in the [[Municipality of Pitogo]], [[Quezon Province|Quezon]].

## Summary

Enacted on September 12, 2019 during a special session held at [[Lady Ester Grand Villa Resort]], [[Sta. Cruz, Laguna]], this ordinance establishes policies for providing electricity access to beneficiary households in [[Pitogo]]. The measure recognizes that many residents in the municipality lack access to electricity. Under this ordinance, property owners are required to allow electricity cables and connections to pass through their land so that beneficiary households may connect to the electrical grid. The ordinance was motioned by Councilor [[Benedicta M. Lozada]] with co-authors Councilors [[Paul Timothy C. Villaflor]], [[Esperanza A. Tan]], and [[Carlo L. Jaranilla]]. Councilor [[Ariel A. Enriquez]] was absent from the session. This is a complementary measure to [[MO-06-S2019]], which prescribes similar policies for water supply.

## Key Provisions

- **Declaration of Policy.** Recognizes the need to provide electricity access to underserved families in [[Pitogo]] who lack connection to the electrical grid.
- **Right of Way for Electricity Cables.** Property owners are required to allow electricity cables and connections to pass through their land to reach beneficiary households.
- **No Permission Fees.** Property owners may not charge permission fees or other costs for allowing electrical connections through their property.
- **Beneficiary Coverage.** Applies to eligible beneficiary households (makikinabang na mamamayan) as identified by the municipal government.
- **Grid Connection.** Beneficiary households are authorized to connect to the electrical grid through the established right of way.
- **Effectivity.** Takes effect upon approval.
